ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The large square is divided by thick lines into several larger regions. The upper-left corner region is further divided into a 3×3 grid of small squares, of which 7 small squares are shaded gray and 2 small squares are white. In the lower-right corner there is a larger gray square, whose side length equals the total side length of 3 small squares in the upper-left corner. The large regions in the upper-right corner and lower-left corner are white. Reasoning: Take the smallest visible small square in the upper-left corner as the area unit. The upper-left 3×3 grid has a total of 9 unit small squares, of which 7 are gray. According to the dividing lines in the figure, the side length of the entire large square is equivalent to 6 such small unit side lengths, so the total area is 6×6=36 unit small squares. The side length of the gray large square in the lower-right corner is 3 units, so its area is 3×3=9 unit small squares. The total gray area is 7+9=16 unit small squares. Therefore the proportion of the gray part in the entire large square is 16/36=4/9.

raw_record.question_text: A large square is divided into smaller squares, as shown. What fraction of the large square is shaded grey?

method.method_draft: Use the smallest visible square as the unit. From the image, note that the upper-left part is a 3-by-3 grid of equal small squares; 7 of these 9 small squares are grey. The line below that grid and the vertical divider show the whole large square can be viewed as a 6-by-6 grid of those same small-square units: the bottom-right grey square is 3 small-square units by 3 small-square units, so it contributes 9 grey unit squares. Thus grey area = 7 + 9 = 16 unit squares, while total area = 6 by 6 = 36 unit squares. The requested fraction is 16/36 = 4/9.

推理：以左上角最小可见小正方形为面积单位。左上 3×3 网格共有 9 个单位小正方形，其中灰色有 7 个。根据图中的分割线，整个大正方形的边长相当于 6 个这样的小单位边长，所以总面积是 6×6=36 个单位小正方形。右下角灰色大正方形的边长是 3 个单位，因此面积是 3×3=9 个单位小正方形。灰色总面积为 7+9=16 个单位小正方形。因此灰色部分占整个大正方形的比例是 16/36=4/9。
